headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 21, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense. Dingler hit a home run (17) on a fly ball to center field, contributing to the Tigers' win. The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, securing a 10-2 victory, with Sal Stewart leading the Reds' offense with 2 hits, 6 RBIs, and 4 at-bats. The Toronto Blue Jays secured an 8-6 win over the Chicago Cubs, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win and Louis Varland notching the save.

Several players have been affected by injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Blas Castaño, a right-hander for the Colorado Rockies, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain, effective retroactive to June 18, 2026. Other injured players include Josh Ekness of the Miami Marlins, Liam Hicks of the Miami Marlins, Luis Severino of the Athletics, Jack Leiter of the Texas Rangers, Adley Rutschman of the Baltimore Orioles, Blake Treinen of the Los Angeles Dodgers, and Isiah Kiner-Falefa of the Boston Red Sox.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Atlanta Braves traded RHP Tyler Schoff to the Atlanta Braves, while the Chicago Cubs acquired RHP Jayden Murray from the Houston Astros in exchange for 1B Cameron Sisneros. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded SS Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash, and the Pittsburgh Pirates acquired C Joey Bart from the Atlanta Braves in exchange for RHP Hunter Stratton.
